skill.description: Use Flux 1 Kontext Pro on RunComfy for precise single-image edits. The skill explains prompt patterns, model limits, CLI invocation, and routing choices.
skill.summary: Edit one source image with Flux 1 Kontext Pro through RunComfy.
skill.author: agentspace-so

security_audit.summary: The skill is a transparent RunComfy wrapper for Flux Kontext Pro and does not contain prompt-injection language. Most static hits are Markdown false positives, but the skill intentionally uses a local CLI, remote model API calls, and local token storage.

remediation.issue: Remote model processing of user media and prompts
remediation.suggestion: Add a concise privacy notice before invocation that prompts and image URLs are sent to RunComfy for processing.
Document token revocation and recommend RUNCOMFY_TOKEN for ephemeral CI environments.
Keep command arguments fixed, require user confirmation before running the CLI, and validate output directories before download.

content.user_title: Edit Images with Flux Kontext Pro
content.value_statement: Precise image edits can drift when prompts are vague or the wrong model is used. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Flux Kontext Pro on RunComfy.
actual_capabilities: Selects Flux Kontext Pro for precise edits on one source image.
Builds preservation-first prompts for identity, pose, framing, and brand details.
Shows the RunComfy CLI command shape for model execution.
Documents supported inputs such as prompt, image URL, aspect ratio, and seed.
Explains when to route work to sibling image models instead.
limitations: It supports one source image per edit request.
It depends on a RunComfy account, CLI access, and network availability.
It requires publicly fetchable image URLs for model input.
Complex multi-step edits may need separate sequential passes.

use_cases.title: Refine Product Visuals
use_cases.description: Change label text, colors, or small props while preserving lighting and product shape.

use_cases.title: Prepare Campaign Variants
use_cases.description: Create controlled variants from one approved image without changing the core composition.

use_cases.title: Prototype Visual Changes
use_cases.description: Test a focused edit before committing design time to manual image production.

prompt_templates.title: Simple Local Edit
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one clear change.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Flux Kontext Pro to edit this image. Keep the main subject unchanged. Add [specific object or detail].

prompt_templates.title: Preserve Brand Details
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a product or brand asset.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Flux Kontext Pro. Keep the product shape, lighting, camera angle, and background unchanged. Replace only [old detail] with [new detail].

prompt_templates.title: Create Seeded Variants
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for repeatable comparison edits.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Flux Kontext Pro with a seed. Keep identity and framing unchanged. Generate a focused variant that changes only [single visual attribute].

prompt_templates.title: Plan Sequential Edits
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with several controlled changes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Flux Kontext Pro in separate passes. First preserve [critical elements] and change [edit one]. Then review before applying [edit two].

output_examples.input: A portrait needs a small prop added while preserving the person and clothing.
output_examples.output: The assistant prepares a preservation-first edit request that adds the prop and keeps face, pose, clothing, and framing unchanged.

output_examples.input: A product bottle needs brand text changed from ALPHA to AURA.
output_examples.output: The assistant requests a focused label text edit while preserving bottle shape, label style, table, and lighting.

output_examples.input: A campaign image needs several changes across the background and outfit.
output_examples.output: The assistant splits the work into sequential passes to reduce drift and review each change.

best_practices: Use one clear edit instruction per run.
State the elements that must remain unchanged before the requested change.
Use a seed when comparing variants or repeating a result.
anti_patterns: Do not combine many unrelated edits in one prompt.
Do not use this skill for multi-image reference workflows.
Do not submit private images unless RunComfy processing is acceptable.

faq.question: What model does this skill use?
faq.answer: It uses Flux 1 Kontext Pro from Black Forest Labs through the RunComfy Model API.

faq.question: Does it generate images from scratch?
faq.answer: No. It is designed for editing one existing source image.

faq.question: What inputs are required?
faq.answer: A text prompt and one publicly fetchable image URL are required.

faq.question: Can it edit many images at once?
faq.answer: No. The skill recommends another model for multi-image workflows.

faq.question: Does it need a RunComfy account?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented workflow requires the RunComfy CLI and account authentication.

faq.question: What should users avoid sending?
faq.answer: Users should avoid private or sensitive images unless they accept remote model processing.
